plan.notes: Official CSUDH 2025-2026 Academic Catalog, Psychology B.A. program page, 4-Year Roadmap section (Plan of Study Grid). Semester sums reconcile exactly with printed Hours; total 120. GENUINE CATALOG STALENESS PRESERVED: this roadmap still uses the pre-2025 CSU GE lettering (A1/A2/A3, B1/B2/B3/B4/B5, C/D, E, F, C3, D3) while other 2025-2026 program pages use the new numeric GE pattern (1A, 1B, 2, 3A ...); transcribed verbatim, not normalized. 'PSY 330 or PSY 331' modeled as a choice slot with code = first-listed option per convention. 'Major Elective (select one from groups 1-7)' slots reference the catalog's seven elective groups (Group 1 Biopsychology through Group 7 cross-group option), summarized in choice notes. 'Research Experience Lecture'/'Research Experience Seminar' are the paired advanced-methods + seminar sequences (PSY 411&412, 413&414, 415&416, 417&418, 419&420); modeled as paired choice slots. Prereq arrays empty: the roadmap publishes no per-course prerequisites and none are invented; sequencing follows the official roadmap order.
